chunks: Ibn Mahbub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abi Basir, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
“Amir al-Mu'minin ruled concerning a man who cut off his wife’s breast. He said: Then I would impose upon him, for her, half of the diyah.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Imam 'Ali عليه السلام in his role as judicial authority
key_terms.أُغَرِّمُهُ: I impose financial liability upon him
key_terms.ثَدْيَ: the breast, the injured bodily organ
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man, the offender in this case
key_terms.نِصْفَ الدِّيَةِ: half of the prescribed blood-money compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man cuts off his wife’s breast in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a judicial ruling of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding bodily injury inflicted by a husband upon his wife. It establishes that cutting off her breast entails financial liability of half the diyah, showing the legal protection of bodily integrity and rights within marriage.
